chapters: Dr. Mara Quill stood on the lunar hub gallery rail and checked the log twice. Captain Nico Vellum named the ice haul vector and kept the cryogenic bus seated. Mara Quill asked for the count. Nico Vellum answered from the observation window. Dr. Mara Quill told Captain Nico Vellum that Mara Quill would hold the watch. Captain Nico Vellum told Dr. Mara Quill that Nico Vellum would keep the rail. Elena Voss is not in this fixture. Bastian Kane is not in this fixture. The gallery rail stayed cold. The lunar hub hummed. The pumps ticked. The deck held. Dr. Mara Quill logged the bus. Captain Nico Vellum logged the habitat vote. Mara Quill and Nico Vellum left the lunar hub together after one pump tick.
